title: ぽんぽん卓球 ～TABLE TENNIS～
tagline: うって、かえして。もう一球。
coreMechanic: A physical ball travels on a bounded table with horizontal position, height, gravity, net and side-specific bounces; move racket sideways and contact after a legal bounce

inputs.paddle: mouse position / horizontal drag / arrows or A,D / 44px direction controls
inputs.pause: Escape, button; hidden/blur pause, manual resume

rules.serve: alternate each 2 points; each point from 10-10; legal net service is a let
rules.ball: self then opponent bounce on serve, opponent bounce on returns, double bounce/out/net fail

practice: Isolated score-free actual rallies. Continue freely; no production RUN, BEST or match statistics
bestStorage: Atomic validated match/ball/bounce/score/nullable existing observer UUID plus separate local report ID and bounded reporting ledger
humanReview: Author subjective and physical smartphone play pending; pre-play prototype publication authorized
telemetry: Common lifecycle plus serve, 10/20/50 rally milestones, point/game_end; no frames; practice separate; remote collection disabled until production Worker registration confirmed
